title: Jackett
descript: Jackett is an indexer proxy for media managers. It translates searches from Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr and other tools into the APIs of hundreds of torrent trackers, and returns the results in the standard Torznab/Newznab format, so one search API works across many sites. This package runs the official LinuxServer.io Jackett image as a non-root container; its configuration and indexer definitions live in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine. Add the indexers you use in the Jackett UI, then copy the Torznab feed URL (with its API key) into your media manager. Jackett does not download anything itself and does not include any tracker. Data is stored in DockerAppData/jackettdocker. Back it up before uninstalling with data removal. The page is plain HTTP on the LAN.
release_note: 1. First release: Jackett 0.24.3030 from Docker Hub, running as a non-root container; configuration and indexer definitions live in the application data folder.

data_notes: `config` holds `Jackett/ServerConfig.json`, the indexer definitions and logs; copying it is a complete backup.
design_notes: **Runs as a non-root container.** Verified on real hardware as uid 1000.
**One volume.** All configuration, indexer definitions and logs live below `/config`.
**Health check** probes the web UI on container port 9117 (it answers with a redirect).
**Fixed image tag, never `:latest`**, Docker Hub only, no `privileged`, no `network_mode: host`, no Docker socket, no `cap_add`.
limitations: No trackers are included; you add the indexers you have access to.
Jackett does not download media; it only provides search results to a media manager.
The page is plain HTTP on the LAN; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
Docker applications cannot be upgraded in place in the App Center: updating means uninstalling and reinstalling, which keeps the data folder.

runtime_files.purpose: indexer definitions, API key and UI settings
